hypothesis: Adding only an exact-zero source-relative spatial projection (dx,dz,r) will improve same-medium unseen-source calibration and independent confirmation by at least 20% over r23 after the same 1000 updates, without regressing either fit family by more than 5%.
expected_mechanism: Explicit displacement and radius features expose the source-centered Green-field geometry at every pixel. The U-Net can then learn how a source move changes coefficient fields instead of inferring relative position indirectly from a global embedding and blurred source map.
nature_evidence_role: This experiment tests general utility across unseen source configurations with an independent confirmation panel. Passing it is necessary but not sufficient for a broad Nature-level method claim.

single_conceptual_variable.name: source_relative_spatial_features
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: zero-init projection of dx,dz,r before the Helmholtz U-Net
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: r20 update-2600 initialization, onset-phase off, fit/calibration/confirmation records, 96 bins, frequency gate, loss, optimizer, learning rates, update budget, seed and metric

panels.confirmation_truth_access: opened once at all saved times after checkpoint freeze

primary_metric: relative reduction versus r23 in all-saved calibration and confirmation aggregate relative L2

acceptance.strong_source_gate: all fit, calibration and confirmation aggregate/family relative L2 <= 0.10

failure_signal: Reject if calibration or confirmation improves by less than 20%, either fit family exceeds 1.05 times its r23 value, or any non-finite/OOM/binding/resource failure occurs.
rollback: Preserve r20-r27 artifacts. On failure disable the optional source-relative branch and move to the coarse-propagator residual priority; do not tune validation/test_id.
